memory_delta.chinese_diary_title: attempt-018 精华瓶最终候选样本经验
memory_delta.chinese_diary_content: attempt-018 已形成可封存的精华瓶商品图最终候选样本。有效经验是：提示词需要同时约束完整瓶身、底部留白、空白可品牌化标签、无可读文字、无 logo 幻觉、柔和棚拍反射和高端护肤质感。该样本适合作为未来精华瓶 hero image 的参考，但正式品牌交付仍需要标签文案或品牌视觉设计。

preserved_original.prompt_en: premium skincare serum bottle product hero image, complete full bottle fully visible from gold dropper top to rounded glass base, generous bottom margin below the bottle, no cropping, one centered bottle occupying most of a square frame, frosted translucent glass bottle with warm amber serum inside, elegant metallic gold dropper cap, blank satin cream label panel with no readable text and no logo, refined white and soft warm gray studio background, subtle grounded reflection, clean cosmetic studio lighting, realistic glass thickness and edge highlights, high-end ecommerce beauty product photography

memory_safety.safety_notes_cn: 未包含密钥、token、cookie、密码、客户隐私或图片二进制；file_ref 使用项目相对路径。
